title: ItColBERT: An Italian-Specialised Late-Interaction Retriever
abstract: arXiv:2609.26856v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Neural information retrieval for Italian is served almost entirely by multilingual models. Several multi-vector (late-interaction) retrievers include Italian among dozens of languages, and several strong Italian dense embedders exist, but as of August 2026 no late-interaction retriever specialised on Italian had been released. We present ItColBERT, a 135M-parameter Italian ColBERT trained with PyLate following the ColBERT-Zero recipe: initialise from a checkpoint that already retrieves, then apply supervised contrastive training followed by single-teacher distillation, for a total of roughly 14.5 GPU-hours on one RTX 3090. Across four Italian retrieval benchmarks it outperforms every general-purpose late-interaction baseline we tested except one (mLateOn), at 2-4.4x fewer parameters than every baseline but one of comparable size. translated_title: ItColBERT：一个面向意大利语的专用后期交互检索器
translated_abstract: 意大利语的神经信息检索几乎完全由多语言模型承担。目前已有若干多向量（后期交互）检索器将意大利语包含在数十种语言之中，也存在多个强大的意大利语稠密嵌入模型，但截至2026年8月，尚未有专门针对意大利语的后期交互检索器发布。我们提出了ItColBERT，一个1.35亿参数的意大利语ColBERT模型，使用PyLate按照ColBERT-Zero训练配方构建：先从一个已具备检索能力的检查点初始化，然后进行有监督对比训练，最后进行单教师蒸馏，在一块RTX 3090上总共仅耗时约14.5个GPU小时。在四个意大利语检索基准上，它超越了我们所测试的所有通用后期交互基线（仅一个mLateOn除外），且参数量比除一个规模相近基线外的所有基线少2到4.4倍。我们的主要实证发现是方法学层面的，且部分为负面结果。在唯一一个干净的域外基准（原文在此截断）……
tldr: 该论文提出了首个专门面向意大利语的135M参数后期交互检索器ItColBERT，通过ColBERT-Zero训练配方（监督对比训练加单教师蒸馏）仅用约14.5个GPU小时，即在四个意大利语检索基准上超越了几乎所有通用多语言基线。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces ItColBERT, the first Italian-specialised late-interaction retriever (135M parameters), trained via the ColBERT-Zero recipe in only ~14.5 GPU-hours, outperforming nearly all general-purpose multilingual baselines on four Italian retrieval benchmarks.
